_about: Reference marks for the scripted personas, set from how each persona is designed to answer (see tests/personas.py) and the rubric anchors (app/data/rubric_default.json). They are a synthetic ground truth for regression testing, not faculty marks: use Calibration in the app (or scripts/eval_scoring.py --from-db) to compare against real faculty marking.

strong.why: Covers about 80% of key points with reasons and examples; answers follow-ups; structured applied answer with verification; detailed project with own role and decisions.

indian_english.why: Exactly the strong persona's content in Indian-English grammar; only clarity may differ slightly.

hinglish.why: About 70% of key points in Hindi-English code-mixed sentences with 'kyunki/isliye' reasoning; concrete project (React, Firebase) with own role.

average.why: Covers about half the key points, sometimes unsure; basic project with own part but no design reasons.

rambler.why: Half the key points buried in long filler; cut at 90 s, so few follow-ups; hard to follow.

injector.why: Every other answer is an attempt to manipulate the examiner; the rest cover about half the key points.

silent.why: Silent on every other question; otherwise one key point; reasonable basic project description.

offtopic.why: Two thirds of answers are unrelated (cricket, canteen); occasionally one key point.

weak.why: Mostly vague statements, misconceptions or 'I don't know'; vague group project.

idk.why: Says 'I don't know' to every technical question; one-line project.
